source:
\set VERBOSITY terse
CREATE TABLE
\g
\echo SEND_STATE syntax-send :SQLSTATE
SELECT 1 AS ok
\g
\echo SEND_STATE success-send :SQLSTATE
SELECT 1 / 0
\g
\echo SEND_STATE divide-send :SQLSTATE
SELECT '\g' AS literal
\g
\echo SEND_STATE quoted-send :SQLSTATE
SELECT $tag$x
\g
y$tag$ AS literal
\g
\echo SEND_STATE dollar-send :SQLSTATE
SELECT 2 -- \g in a SQL comment
\g
\echo SEND_STATE comment-send :SQLSTATE
SELECT missing_send_probe()
\g
\echo SEND_STATE missing-send :SQLSTATE
SELECT 3;
\echo SEND_STATE ordinary-semicolon :SQLSTATE
output:
\set VERBOSITY terse
CREATE TABLE
\g
ERROR:  syntax error at end of input at character 13
\echo SEND_STATE syntax-send :SQLSTATE
SEND_STATE syntax-send 42601
SELECT 1 AS ok
\g
 ok 
----
  1
(1 row)

\echo SEND_STATE success-send :SQLSTATE
SEND_STATE success-send 00000
SELECT 1 / 0
\g
ERROR:  division by zero
\echo SEND_STATE divide-send :SQLSTATE
SEND_STATE divide-send 22012
SELECT '\g' AS literal
\g
 literal 
---------
 \g
(1 row)

\echo SEND_STATE quoted-send :SQLSTATE
SEND_STATE quoted-send 00000
SELECT $tag$x
\g
y$tag$ AS literal
\g
 literal 
---------
 x      +
 \g     +
 y
(1 row)

\echo SEND_STATE dollar-send :SQLSTATE
SEND_STATE dollar-send 00000
SELECT 2 -- \g in a SQL comment
\g
 ?column? 
----------
        2
(1 row)

\echo SEND_STATE comment-send :SQLSTATE
SEND_STATE comment-send 00000
SELECT missing_send_probe()
\g
ERROR:  function missing_send_probe() does not exist at character 8
\echo SEND_STATE missing-send :SQLSTATE
SEND_STATE missing-send 42883
SELECT 3;
 ?column? 
----------
        3
(1 row)

\echo SEND_STATE ordinary-semicolon :SQLSTATE
SEND_STATE ordinary-semicolon 00000
